_comment: The Bridgey ios lane for RR CI, as the coordinator task the CI owner thread adds. It needs a Mac with Xcode 27 and its iOS simulator runtime (CoreSimulator matching Xcode), Rust with rustup, and python3. On GitHub's hosted macOS runners it runs through .github/workflows/rr-ci-hosted.yml (workflow_dispatch, no secrets). scripts/rr/build-ios.sh makes and deletes its own simulators and runs a scripted peer on free local ports. See ios/README.md.
